translations.sentence_ed026d68003639c3781b37ff65c7bb4: You and I don't have a lot in common.
translations.sentence_57bda37f49f096c58129945ce49f160: It seems we have nothing further to discuss.
translations.sentence_4bb5ed6d0d3a247c474f172316c7c5e: There are still things that we need to do.
translations.sentence_52f034ceaffbefa43b0b9d1dd5346d0: The trouble is that we have no money.
translations.sentence_12c456f25f710346a7fe3654fafad06: Got to look forward, that's what life is.
translations.sentence_8280026c435f63863c75a8c78ad1edf: We aren't scared of people like you.
translations.sentence_d3496c57f84876d25df7cb276f34988: Alright, let's get this damn thing over with, then.
translations.sentence_350cfc8108487ac5fed1d4634c4acd7: There's no way back. We have to keep going.
translations.sentence_1329c34e3fe3558d1e6e8f0825a06f8: Why do we have to do it?
translations.sentence_96bd968dd0357f2a604deff4abb6e9a: We have to find out why this happened.
translations.sentence_12fe704c662ee35289538bfa63bf5a0: I'd say we have a problem.
translations.sentence_912a335b004a27ff714c5cdfd496865: Do we really need to leave now?
translations.sentence_4032098fa55ac01d5a3285a7e303a17: Well... we need to start corralling the herd.
translations.sentence_a2b5f2e8039c5e56a1035f6f11aea30: We have nothing else to lose.
translations.sentence_9f919fc678387f332b887ef97a3bbaf: - We gotta camp here tonight, y'all.
translations.sentence_dca416d96e2d7599d46ec0ffa5cf628: We have to find a way to correct that.
translations.sentence_da95d0c06a78d4d656e86b8c1fe3c7a: We need to find a way to bring you together with my father.
translations.sentence_7f064433de4c951c4a451138adcaa72: The real problem is that you don't even know that we have a problem.
translations.sentence_df193c1e57fa672a14fcd2b54c6e8a8: Now. Now, let's see what we got in here.
translations.sentence_e45dd5fd3bfde4b42a9225f52cbb4a7: We have lots of other things to do.
translations.sentence_237f1c3b859c6817e13d5740f47b9a3: Do we have to do all this?
translations.sentence_8cf62fcebfd27a34c8f408d355c1b6f: And we have to be committed.
translations.sentence_3143bd33fa54a7784675249151c6c6e: We don't have enough money to buy a new car.
translations.sentence_be20b5e5e43d3d582195a2f8d7584cf: We have to trust each other now.
translations.sentence_deeaee6c80ee15dadbe752e840332fa: We can't afford to buy a new car.
